role_positioning_strategy.clinical_research: Lead with lab operations + protocol/SOP rigor + specimen handling + documentation discipline + bilingual patient interaction. Frame phlebotomy as direct study-visit and specimen-collection experience; frame lab-director years as protocol/quality governance. Add CITI/GCP certificate to strengthen instantly.
role_positioning_strategy.lab_operations: Lead with 11 years directing labs + current U.S. hospital lead role. Emphasize staffing, QC, compliance, workflow, and training. This is the strongest overlap between his history and U.S. titles.
role_positioning_strategy.pathology_cytology_assistant: Lead with cytology specialization + biopathology master's + specimen handling. Position as academically over-qualified for assistant roles = high interview probability and fast onboarding.
role_positioning_strategy.specimen_processing: Lead with accessioning/specimen-integrity language and current hospital throughput. Supervisor angle uses his leadership history.
role_positioning_strategy.phlebotomy_lead: Direct match. Lead with current title, hospital setting, training, and bilingual patient care. Highest probability of interview and offer.
role_positioning_strategy.qa_qc: Lead with lab QC/compliance, SOPs, documentation, and audit-readiness from director years.
role_positioning_strategy.teaching_training: Lead with professor/coordinator years + current staff training. Ideal for phlebotomy instructor, biomedical tutor, or Portuguese-language medical/science tutoring.
role_positioning_strategy.data_coordinator: Lead with documentation discipline, lab terminology fluency, and detail orientation; remote-friendly and low certification barrier.
